E1303

`positional` expects 2 arguments (name, help), got N

What

`positional` expects 2 arguments (name, help), got N

Why

`ArgsSpec.positional(name, help)` registers a required positional argument; both name and help are required.

Fix

Pass exactly two strings: the positional name and a help description, e.g. `.positional("input", "file to process")`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1303: tests/ui/args_spec_bad_positional_arity.stderr.

Error [E1303]: `positional` expects 2 arguments (name, help), got 1
  --> tests/ui/args_spec_bad_positional_arity.jet:5:25
    |
  5 |     spec :: args.spec().positional("input")
    |                         ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `ArgsSpec.positional(name, help)` registers a required positional argument
 Fix: pass exactly two strings: the positional name and a help description
